api_analysis.hypothesis: The compile error is due to using the same name `sdata` for extern shared memory arrays of different types (float and int64_t) in two kernel templates within the same translation unit. CUDA/NVCC treats these as conflicting declarations because extern shared memory arrays with the same name but different types are not allowed in the same scope/file. The fix is to rename one of the shared memory arrays, e.g. use `sdata_count` in the count_nonzero kernel, while keeping the kernel logic unchanged.
